name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Trump Administration to Impose New Tariffs on Brazil
changes.summary: The United States accused the country of unfair trade practices. The tariff will replace ones that the Supreme Court struck down.

changes.title: Diesel Prices Hit $5 a Gallon Again, Up 33% Since Start of Iran War
changes.summary: U.S. diesel prices first surpassed $5 a gallon in March. Renewed fighting in the Persian Gulf and reduced refinery capacity is once again pushing up prices.

changes.title: Maps Show Where Wildfire Smoke Will Darken Skies on Thursday
changes.summary: Air quality in several cities reached hazardous levels on Thursday morning as smoke was expected to move across North America.

changes.title: Wildfire Smoke Turns Skies Orange Across the U.S., and Democrats Make a Big Shift on Israel
changes.summary: Plus, why Gen Z is turning to trade schools.

changes.title: H.R. McMaster on the U.S.-Iran feud over the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: H.R. McMaster, a CBS News contributor and President Trump's former national security adviser in his first term, joins CBS News 24/7 Mornings to discuss the current situation in the Strait of Hormuz as the U.S.-Iran feud ramps up.

changes.title: Climate extremes fuel explosive wildfires in Canada and the U.S., experts say
changes.summary: One climatologist said "a perfect storm" of climate extremes primed the western U.S. for one of its worst fire seasons in a decade. Meanwhile, Canadian wildfire smoke fills the air.

changes.title: Trump wants a permanent fence around the D.C. park known for White House protests
changes.summary: The Trump administration wants to install permanent fencing around Lafayette Park, directly outside the White House. It's long been a popular spot for protesters, who worry barriers will change that. (Image credit: U.S. Commission of Fine Arts).

changes.title: Trump immediately fires the new court-appointed top prosecutor in Seattle
changes.summary: President Donald Trump fired the new top U.S. prosecutor in Seattle on Wednesday less than an hour after the attorney was unanimously appointed by the federal judges in the district, highlighting tensions between the courts and the president over the powerful positions.

changes.title: America already tried permanent daylight saving time. Could it work now?
changes.summary: It's an idea whose time, as it were, may have come — again.
